content:
anya: quick heads-up: bringing up a new int8 encoder on canary and we're seeing a small spike in funcall JSON parse failures
mike: numbers?
anya: jumped to ~2.1% on canary vs 0.15% baseline; failures cluster on toolcall suffixes with weird control bytes
sam: any raw examples?
anya: from logs: ```INVOKE_RESP: {
  "tool": "geo_lookup",
  "args": {
    "q": "nearby cafe",
    "loc": "NYC"
  }
}
```
mike: that trailing \u0002 will break strict parser for sure
lia: hypothesis: quant changed tokenization so streaming boundary includes control byte previously absent
sam: can you repro locally?
anya: yes, `scripts/repro/int8_toolcall_smoke.sh` reproduces ~3/180 failures for me
ci-bot: build 2026-03-26-02 deployed to canary pool A
mike: short-term: add sanitizer to strip 0x00-0x1F from tool output and a json-repair fallback (json5) and tag which repair was used
lia: add a sentinel wrapper for tool outputs too: `<<<RDW_JSON>>>...<<<END>>>` so parser ignores stray bytes between wrappers
sam: agree on mitigation but we must run a micro-quant sweep to find param that recreates baseline. I'll set up sweep over symmetric vs asymmetric and per-channel scales
anya: rolling sanitizer+wrapper to 15% canary now
ci-bot: sanitizer roll 1749991111 -> 15% at 02:12 UTC
anya: sanitizer cohort parse_fail down to 0.3% (from 2.1%), so mitigation helps
mike: good. next steps: sam runs token-diff between fp16 and int8 for failing prompts to find first differing token; lia adds schema telemetry to record `schema_failure_type` and `repair_action`
anya: filed RED-ML-1290 with repro, samples, and S3 links: s3://canaries/int8/1749991111/fails.jsonl
ci-bot: RED-ML-1290 created by anya at 02:20 UTC
mike: owners?
anya: i'll own triage + mitigation. sam owns quant sweep. lia owns telemetry and dashboard alert
sam: ETA for first sweep pass: 24h
lia: adding alert if parse_fail_rate > 1% sustained 10m
anya: we'll keep sanitizer+wrapper in canary until sweep finds safe quant config; if found, plan a staged rollout to dedicated
mike: dont ship wrapper to prod without root-cause sign-off
lia: PR for telemetry incoming
anya: thanks everyone, will post sweep results here
lia: nice triage. :thumbsup:
